text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 50, "unit": "birds", "kind": "count", "span": "On days one and two, Mack saw a total of 50 birds"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 120, "unit": "birds", "kind": "count", "span": "On days four and five, he saw 120 birds"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 20, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "On day six he saw 20"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 90, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "on day seven he saw 90"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 7, "unit": "days", "kind": "count", "span": "day seven: the week runs from day one to day seven"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "birds on days one to five"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "plus day six"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "plus day seven gives the week's total"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s3", "q5"], "out": "s4", "note": "shared over the seven days"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the average number of birds Mack saw per day"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 1.0, "reason": "'day one' labels a day, it is not a bird count"}, {"value": 2.0, "reason": "'day two' labels a day, it is not a bird count"}, {"value": 3.0, "reason": "'day three' labels the day he saw none; adding nothing changes no total"}, {"value": 4.0, "reason": "'day four' labels a day, it is not a bird count"}, {"value": 5.0, "reason": "'day five' labels a day, it is not a bird count"}, {"value": 6.0, "reason": "'day six' labels the day; the 20 birds seen that day are the count"}]}
